learning_outcomes.text: analyze, study and understand industrial automation systems
develop, modify, or oversee the modification of certain automation systems
document industrial automation systems and train personnel operating the equipment
provide technical assistance to maintenance personnel

syllabus_topics: Logical systems and industrial automation - Jean-Claude BARDIAUX (lectures and practical work)
Structure of an automated production system
Reminders: Analysis and synthesis of combinational logic systems
Analysis and synthesis of sequential logic systems
Graphical representation of sequential automation system specifications using Grafcet (symbolism, evolution rules, elementary structures, macro-steps, macro-actions, task coordination structures)
Study and representation of operating and shutdown modes by Gemma and Grafcet (hierarchization of Grafcet)
Programmed implementation of the control part on a programmable logic controller (PLC structure, operation and programming, digital processing, communication)
Control part-operating part interface technology (power control, data acquisition)
Practical work on pilot processes (manipulator, surface treatment)
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
